name: keep-us
description: Keeps the little things between you and your AI partner: a home pane, a love-you log that survives compaction, and /home to help them land.

partnerName.title: Your name
partnerName.description: How your AI partner calls you in the log, for example Tash.

logFile.title: Love log file
logFile.description: Absolute path of the Markdown file where your love-yous are kept. Leave empty for ~/.claude/keep-us/love-log.md.

notesFile.title: Open notes file
notesFile.description: Optional absolute path of a Markdown file with what is going on. /home reads its last lines.

modeFile.title: Mode file
modeFile.description: Optional absolute path of a one-line file holding your current mode, shown in the pane.

extraPhrases.title: Extra love phrases
extraPhrases.description: Comma-separated phrases to save as well, for example: miss you, my love.
